name: pstack-zcode
description: Optional add-ons for pstack-zcode — the ZCode adaptation of Lauren @poteto's pstack workflow. Install the skills collection separately via npx skills add; this marketplace carries what the skills CLI cannot ship (hooks-bearing plugins).

plugins.name: pstack-resident
plugins.description: Opt-in resident mode for pstack-zcode: a SessionStart hook that injects the condensed poteto-mode summary into sessions where poteto-mode is reachable — a project-level install in the tree, or a global install under the home directory. Installing this plugin is the whole opt-in; sessions that cannot reach poteto-mode get nothing.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 可选常驻模式：SessionStart 钩子向 poteto-mode 可达的会话（项目级或全局安装）注入精简纪律摘要，装插件即 opt-in；不可达的会话零注入。
